name: Corda Wrap Boot
description: Not really a boot so much as a structured foot-wrap — thick cord and reclaimed canvas wound in overlapping layers around the foot and lower ankle, then sealed with a coat of flex-resin to hold the shape. A flat rubber pad is bonded to the bottom. They take about an hour to make and last two to three months of hard wear. Some people add a buckle or a lace for structure. Every pair is unique.
functionality: Customizable fit. Fully gene-compatible — can be wrapped around digitigrade or modified feet.
what_it_says: You're at the edge of what money can do for you. Or you're a purist who thinks all footwear is just engineering.
story_hooks: The resin used in a pair matches a specific black-market supplier — a lead in a supply chain investigation.
Someone has been making these boots for the same family for three generations. They know every foot by shape.
